test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Five professors A, B, C, D and E are sitting in a row facing the North (not necessarily in the same order). A is second to the left of D. Only two professors are sitting between C and E. No professor is sitting to the right of E.

How many professors are sitting to the left of D?
solution:
According to the given information, we have:

1) Only two professors are sitting between C and E. No professor is sitting to the right of E.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/53d3e4ba51a06853cd9985bf7fb81e86c9e5e3cedc70327a994cb86c2734f016.png] 

2) A is second to the left of D. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/558d7061ccae44842e5c27e7271ded09609b0e0b092aad767888a3bf8ce1c03b.png] 

3) Thus, the final arrangement is 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/75457b12ffbc919cfe392e7451e34d8619d35bb2f5a55eb478585eeebca43e38.png] 

Thus, there are **2** professors are sitting to the left of D.

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 3**__'.
